notes.title: Update Notes 0.9.6 - Guest Dossiers
notes.notes:
Attention detectives! Introducing the brand-new Guest Dossiers, your ultimate tool for mastering the subtle art of guest interaction.

Each dossier reveals valuable insights about the estate's colorful inhabitants, detailing:
[list]
[*] [b]Personal Insights:[/b] Learn guests' likes, dislikes, fears, and secrets.
[*] [b]Strategic Notes:[/b] Discover which mood is most effective for unlocking each guest's cooperation.
[/list]
Unlocking these dossiers is simple—just initiate a conversation with any guest, and their dossier entry will be immediately accessible after finishing that game. 

Unlock your dossiers and enhance your investigative prowess today!

notes.title: Update Notes 0.9.4 - The Language Update
notes.notes: [p]Bonjour, detectives! Guten Tag, sleuths! こんにちは, investigators! Welcome to our most linguistically lavish update yet - The Language Update![/p][p]Characters have expanded their vocabulary and are now fluent in 30 languages, from Bengali to Bulgarian, Czech to Chinese, and even Hausa to Hungarian![/p][p]While the interface remains in English (keeping you grounded, naturally), you can now interrogate, charm, or accuse suspects in:[/p][p][b]Bengali, Bulgarian, Czech, Dutch, Egyptian Arabic, English, French, German, Greek, Hausa, Hindi, Hungarian, Indonesian, Iranian Persian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Levantine Arabic, Mandarin Chinese, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, Tamil, Turkish, Ukrainian, Urdu, and Vietnamese.[/b][/p][p][i]Please note: This is an experimental update, and perfect translations are not guaranteed.[/i][/p][p]Dive into conversations across cultures, experience mysteries that transcend borders, and remember - no matter the language, a guilty conscience always translates clearly.[/p][p]Happy sleuthing, multilingual detectives![/p]

notes.title: Update Notes 0.9.3 - New Guest: The Captain
notes.notes: [p]A new mysterious guest has arrived at the estate: [b]Captain Evelyn Lin[/b]! With elegance and maritime charm, her refined presence hides a past filled with secrets. Engage her in conversation - perhaps you'll catch hints about her adventurous life at sea.[/p][p]Additionally, your sleuthing now comes with new mood-based achievements! Master your interactions, influence guests’ emotions, and earn recognition for your detective finesse.[/p][p]Welcome aboard, detectives - steady as she goes![/p]

notes.title: Major Update 0.9.0 - The Mood, Mystery & Voice Update!
notes.notes:
Greetings, sharp-eyed detectives! Our biggest update yet has arrived, packed with enhancements guaranteed to elevate your sleuthing skills. Pour yourself another glass of suspiciously bubbly champagne, and let's dive right in!

[b]✨ Introducing the Mood System![/b]
Ever wondered if your charm (or sternness) truly impacts your investigations? Now it does!
[list]
[*][b]Guest Moods[/b]: Your conversational style influences each guest's emotional state. Soothe their nerves, put them on edge, or push too far and watch them close off.
[*][b]Expressive Animations[/b]: Observe the guests' facial expressions reflecting each character’s feelings—are they tense, relaxed, angry, or even a bit intimidated? Pay close attention!
[*][b]Mood Matters[/b]: A guest's mood directly impacts their willingness to share clues. Navigate conversations wisely to uncover their secrets!
[/list]
[b]🕵️ Decode Secret Messages![/b]
The estate is crawling with intrigue, and someone has left mysterious coded clues scattered around.
[list]
[*][b]Caesar Cipher Decoder Wheel[/b]: Arm yourself with the latest detective tech (circa 1920s, naturally)—a sleek and stylish Caesar Cipher Decoder Wheel!
[*][b]Guests Hold the Keys[/b]: Listen carefully—guests may drop hints that help unravel the secrets hidden within coded messages.
[*][b]Crack the Codes[/b]: Decode these scrambled messages to gain crucial evidence against the murderer!
[/list]
[b]🎤 Voice & Conversation Enhancements![/b]
We're enhancing immersion with our experimental voice system!
[list]
[*][b]Unique Character Voices[/b]: Enjoy distinct, emotive voice identities for each guest, adding depth to your interrogations.
[*][b]Talk Directly to Suspects[/b]: Plug in your microphone or headset and interact naturally via speech-to-text transcription. Your voice, your questions, their answers—let the interrogations begin!
[*][i]Note: Character voices are experimental and weekly limits apply.[/i]
[/list]
It's time to don your detective persona and explore the intriguing world of the roaring twenties—every mood, message, and voice brings you closer to solving the perfect crime.

Update Murder Mystery Mayhem AI now, and let your detective adventures reach exciting new heights!

[i]Stay sharp, detectives. The next case awaits![/i]

notes.title: Update Notes 0.8 - The Gallery Update
notes.notes:
Your finest detective work deserves to be remembered! 
Introducing the Gallery, a beautifully crafted album chronicling your investigative career. Leaf through the pages of your solved mysteries, reviewing each killer's identity, their twisted motivations, and the crucial facts that led to their downfall.

[i]Note: Cases will be saved to the Gallery from this update forward.[/i]

We've also included:
[list]
[*] A revamped case report and journal interface
[*] Smooth new UI animations throughout the game
[*] Various bug fixes to ensure a flawless investigative experience
[/list]
Update Murder Mystery Mayhem AI today and start building your legacy of solved cases!

notes.title: Update Notes 0.6.5 - Quicksave Update
notes.notes:
Attention all detectives! We're excited to unveil our latest game-changing feature: Quicksave!

Now you can:
[list]
[*] Save your progress mid-investigation
[*] Take a break without losing your detective work
[*] Return to your case whenever inspiration strikes
[/list]Simply hit the Quicksave button(found in the pause menu) during gameplay, and you'll be able to continue your sleuthing session at a later time. Whether you're interrupted by a urgent telegram or need to dash to a speakeasy, your case will be waiting for you.

Don't let life get in the way of solving the perfect crime. Update Murder Mystery Mayhem AI now and experience the flexibility of Quicksave!

notes.title: Update Notes 0.6 - Dynamic Outro Update
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to introduce our latest feature: the Dynamic Outro!

After you've pieced together the clues and locked in your prime suspect, prepare for a thrilling cinematic recap. Watch as the events of the murder are dramatically reenacted, revealing: 
[list]
[*] The chilling aftermath of the crime
[*] The cause of death that set your investigation in motion
[*] The unmasking of the killer in a shocking reveal
[/list]
This procedurally generated sequence adapts to each unique case, providing a satisfying conclusion to your investigation. Will your deductions prove correct, or will the truth shock you?

Update now and experience this new feature in Murder Mystery Mayhem AI!
